description: Variation of condition 2 (Approved drawings) of planning permission ref : 26/00184/FUL (Redevelopment of the site to provide six dwellinghouses and the provision of cycle parking, refuse storage, landscaping and associated works) granted on : 25/08/2026.Variation sought  :Change to the siting of houses 3 and 4 at the south west corner of the site. The amendment would push the pair of houses 1.7m back from the frontage of the site and to align with house 1 and 2 and the flatted block to the west (1-27 Leaf Grove). The back garden sizes for house 3 would reduce from 53sqm to 42sqm and for house 4 would reduce from 47sqm to 36sqm.Front garden sizes for houses 3 and 4 to increase from 26sqm to 34sqm each.Garden space remains in excess of the 30sqm.Relocation of bin and bike stores of houses 1 to 4 to the rear.The distance between houses 3 and 4 and house 5 at the rear is 10 meters at first floor level. The same measures to remove any potential for overlooking of habitable rooms are retained.
